propositions: test_a_missing_epic_field_aborts_provisioning stubs /rest/api/2/field to omit Epic Link, forcing the readiness poll to expire against the production budget of 120 seconds
the test performs ~120 iterations sleeping ~1 second each, burning wall-clock time that is pure idle and unnecessary for a unit test
the readiness code honours JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT environment variable, allowing the budget to be overridden without changing production code
setting the budget to zero ensures exactly one deterministic field poll (before monotonic() >= deadline check, before sleep), making the poll count a guard against regression
the fix uses monkeypatch.setenv to override the timeout per-test without leaking to other tests or production paths
reducing wall-clock time from ~120s to <5ms while maintaining the same functional assertion (missing Epic Link still raises AssertionError)
